items.title: Founder & Developer
items.summary: Building a student productivity platform around focus, planning, and daily structure.

Using product thinking to keep the experience purposeful and easy to navigate.

items.title: Frontend & UI Development
items.summary: Creating responsive portfolio and project interfaces with React, Tailwind, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.

Practicing reusable UI patterns with a strong focus on mobile responsiveness.

items.title: AI & Automation Experiments

highlights: Testing how natural interaction can improve task flow and reduce friction.
Turning experiments into working prototypes with practical user-facing outcomes.

items.title: Cyber Security Exploration

Building technical depth that supports more reliable and resilient software.
